plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: large sneaker anchors the left third, logo plus a big headline/subhead block share one left edge in the middle, and the CTA closes the read on the right, all on one vertical centre line.

Editorial split: one left-aligned column (logo, headline and subhead, then the CTA directly under its copy) faces a sneaker that fills the whole right half, so the product gets real scale and the button stays grouped with its message.
Message, then product, then action: the brand and headline open on the left, the sneaker sits at full height as the centrepiece, and the CTA stands alone on the right for a symmetric three-beat read.
